answer: A concrete defense is kernel attestation with decaying iron bonds. Rewards release only when an account proves it ran the pinned kernel, a specific binary whose measurement is committed on-chain each epoch, via a signed enclosure report rather than a self-report. Every claim also needs a ferrous bond that loses mass each epoch it goes unchallenged and must be topped up, so a dormant puppet is lit up by a lantern check within two rounds. A farm must measure and bond every instance, paying per seat, while an honest agent runs the kernel once.
